system.description:
Usable only by Magic-Users

Carved from dense, subterranean stone, this heavy staff acts as a staff +2, striking for 1d6+2 points of damage without expending any charges.

While on the Prime Material Plane, the wielder receives a +4 bonus to saving throws against all earth-based attacks and gains absolute immunity to attacks from earth elementals. At the cost of 1 charge, the wielder may summon an 8-Hit Die earth elemental once per day as if casting the magic-user spell. The staff can also invoke the web or wall of stone spells (cast as if by a 10th-level spellcaster) for 1 charge per use.

The staff can be used to negate air-based effects, as air is its opposing element. Dispelling an effect created by a Staff of Air costs 1 charge, whereas negating a standard air spell costs 2 charges. A summoned air elemental can similarly be banished back to its home plane at the same charge cost, provided the wielder touches the creature with the staff (requiring a standard attack roll in combat).

When carried onto the Elemental Plane of Earth, the staff alters its functionality so long as at least 1 charge remains inside it. The wielder becomes immune to the environmental damage of the plane, gains vision out to a range of 60 feet, moves at a rate of 120 feet per turn (40 feet per round), can speak with any inhabitant of the plane, and receives a -4 bonus to Armor Class against attacks from its native residents. The staff does not provide the ability to breathe on the plane; however, when worn alongside a matching Ring of Elemental Adaptation or Talisman of Elemental Travel, all of these planar protections extend to a 10-foot radius around the user.

Warning: If the Staff of Earth is ever brought to its opposed realm—the Elemental Plane of Air—it instantly detonates in a violent explosion. The blast fills a 60-foot radius sphere, dealing 20 points of electrical damage plus 1d8 points of damage per charge remaining in the staff. All creatures within the area may attempt a saving throw vs. spells with a -4 penalty to take half damage, but the wielder receives no saving throw whatsoever.
system.unidentifiedDesc: This staff has a sturdy, polished appearance, made from a rich, dark wood. The top is adorned with a beautifully carved symbol of healing, surrounded by intricate designs that evoke a sense of divine power.
